about: Open sound packs whose every file is CC0. scripts/index_sfx.py reads each maker's page for the archive link, pins its sha256 and indexes each sound. No audio is kept in git.

packs.title: Interface Sounds
packs.author: Kenney
packs.notes: Clicks, drops, toggles, scrolls, confirmations and errors. Kenney's own upload on OpenGameArt (author Kenney, CC0, posted 2020-02-26), read on 2026-11-08. kenney.nl now serves its archives only through short-lived signed links, so this page is the stable source. It may be an older version than kenney.nl's.

packs.title: 100 CC0 SFX
packs.author: rubberduck
packs.notes: The page names 100-CC0-SFX_0.zip (2.9 MB) and CC0. Doors, household items, metal hits, slams, springs, paper and splashes, recorded on a phone.
